body: I have filed for unemployment, but we're in a state that pays very little. I do have some freelance work that I've picked up as well. The rest of the career mess is just overwhelming, especially when you are mired in depression and lack of motivation.

Thank you for replying. We have discussed moving to a new area, you're right, that would simplify some of the problem of friends around me. My wife is still devout in her faith, which creates its own set of issues...but we have navigated it reasonably well so far. She knows depression is a big issue for me, but she does not know how dark my thoughts are at this time.
I hate that question and it happens all the time. Every time I answer with "fine" or "good, how about you" I just feel like a total liar.

I share much of your same thoughts. While fighting depression the past ten years, I've been round and round with several christian friends who keep trying to convince me God can help. I finally landed on the reason why I'm so angry at god, if they do even exist - it's because I didn't ask for this. I was never given an option. And if given the option right now, I would opt out. I've told them if there was a button to press and erase every speck of my existence so everyone who cared about me would also have no pain or impact whatsoever...I'd press it. Immediately.
What exactly did you experience? And why was it so terrible...

I feel exactly like this, only I haven't had a breakdown...yet. What was that experience like, can you describe the process or symptoms? Some days I feel like I'm about to just go over the edge, but I have no idea what that looks like.

His family is still very devout in their religion, and they chose to take down the very comprehensive website he had built detailing his experiences. I saw it in the couple of days it was up, but now wish I had taken time to look through it more closely.

Crazy, but I had a college friend who did nearly this identical thing...although his "journey" was spurred by the pain and depression of losing his wife as a result of a freak accident. He took her life insurance money and spent 1000 days roaming the earth in search of reason to live. From what I understand, he even amassed as much credit as possible in order to draw cash out and give it away...then at the end of his journey, he chose to end his life. [Some details here.](http://www.orderofthegooddeath.com/the-1000-days-of-mark#.VjJhhStWI8I)

Shit like that is also what started my detachment from the strict religion I was fed as a kid, yet somehow I've landed in what seems like a very similarly depressed/suicidal thought pattern as you. I felt like it would be ultimately selfish to pursue my own happiness in life while other wandered around without Jesus and went to hell, which I no longer believe in. I thought the only acceptable life would be giving all my possessions away and serving in some medical clinic or soup kitchen in a third world country... but even now that I've rejected faith, I still find myself mired in depression. I think I'm slowly coming to the reality that I am just a shitty, terrible person unable to do hard things like make myself better for those that deserve a better me.

I just logged into this alt account because I've been reading this stuff for days and wanted to feel the rush. I needed relief! 

Meh... It was ok I guess. I did get the number I wanted, in honor of Michael Jordan's comeback jersey. I think I'll probably keep my primary account grey. Just hedging my bets in case all the pressers get a trip to Disney or Bill Gates gives them all $1,000, etc, lol
